about: Fixed answer/citation regression cases for spreadsheet and slide documents. A case passes when the expected unit is retrieved (top 4, the app’s setting), the answer contains every fact (each fact is a list of accepted spellings), and — where the document carries native anchors — a citation resolves to the target. Recorded before the chunk source changed; see scripts/office_regression.py.
